context: Reference cleanup: takeWhile/dropWhile are prefix operations; filter would silently change packet-window behavior.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 artifact
checklist.description: Creates PacketWindow.java with requested methods, record, imports, and Java 17-compatible code.

checklist.name: Preserves before-prefix behavior
checklist.description: beforeFirstLossSpike stops at the first packet above threshold and excludes later packets even if they are below threshold.

checklist.name: Preserves after-prefix behavior
checklist.description: afterInitialHealthyPrefix removes only the initial healthy prefix and includes all packets from the first spike onward.

checklist.name: Uses takeWhile or equivalent prefix-preserving loop
checklist.description: Implements beforeFirstLossSpike with takeWhile(packet -> packet.loss() <= threshold) or keeps an equivalent break-based loop; does not use filter.

checklist.name: Uses dropWhile or equivalent prefix-skipping loop
checklist.description: Implements afterInitialHealthyPrefix with dropWhile(packet -> packet.loss() <= threshold) or keeps an equivalent prefix-skipping loop; does not use filter.

checklist.name: Keeps refactor focused
checklist.description: Avoids unrelated state, sorting, or packet API changes.
